**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Drop in
solution:
The correct answer is- **'****Pay a casual visit****'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom** 'Drop in****​​'** is 'Pay a casual visit'
 
• Let’s look at the meaning and example of the given phrasal verb:
 
 
• Drop in- "to pay an unexpected or casual visit —often used with on" (एक अप्रत्याशित या आकस्मिक यात्रा का भुगतान करने के लिए—अक्सर on . के साथ प्रयोग किया जाता है)
 
 
• *E.g. I hate to **drop in** on people when they aren't expecting me.*
 
 
 
 
 
• *​​* Thus from the explanation given above, we find that the 4th option is the correct choice.
